caption:
✍️ 'There is' vs 'there are'

✅ Rule: After 'there,' the subject comes after the verb.
❌ There is three reasons to retake the test.
✅ There are three reasons to retake the test.
✅ Quick check: Flip it: 'Three reasons are there.'
